paragraphs.text:
You turn around and leave the door closed behind you. Looking 
down the stairs, you realize that you are not alone. Dominating 
the entryway is Joshua, red-faced and furious. He has a gun in 
his right hand, which he quickly aims in your direction.

You have just a second to hit the ground before he pulls the 
trigger. Perhaps your reflexes are quick enough.

• Make a Dodge roll: if you succeed, go to 132; if you fail, take 
1D10+2 damage. If you survive this, go to 96; however, if this 
reduces you to zero hit points, you are dead. Your visit to Esbury 
is over. THE END.
